title: Input validation
prompt: Reject invalid prices, quantities, and text lengths.

starter.content:
price: float = Field(gt=0)
quantity: int = Field(ge=1, le=500)

expected_output: Invalid inputs return a validation error; valid values pass constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Address the exercise task: Reject invalid prices, quantities, and text lengths.
State prerequisites and expected behavior; include one success case and one invalid/edge case.
Use synthetic data and a disposable local environment; do not include production credentials.
Explain what was actually tested and identify any untested runtime/security assumption.
hints: Read the linked lesson and identify the smallest endpoint/model/dependency needed.
Write a test for the expected result before adding optional features.
Static keyword checks do not execute Python; confirm runtime correctness with pytest or appropriate local tests.
grading_method: Server-side static required-string check plus human review; CodeLeaf does not execute arbitrary learner Python. This draft exercise must not be treated as proof of runtime correctness.
retry_policy: Retries permitted after feedback; completion is recorded idempotently by CodeLeaf. Platform-wide XP rules apply; no course-authored reward override.
